description: Next.js functions and props (`params`, `searchParams`, `cookies()`, `headers()`, `draftMode()`) that return Promises so the framework can decouple static route preparation from request-time I/O.
A Promise passed to pages, layouts, route handlers, and metadata functions that resolves to an object containing the dynamic route segment values for the current URL.
A Promise passed to page components that resolves to the parsed URL query string parameters, opting the reading subtree into dynamic rendering when awaited.
Server-only asynchronous helpers that resolve to read-only stores during Server Component rendering and mutable cookie stores inside Server Actions and Route Handlers.
The React hook used inside synchronous Client Components to read the resolved value of a `params` or `searchParams` Promise passed down from a Server Component.
